title: SalesPatriot podcast with Augie Fabela from Aurora Defense Group (Hosted by Nelson Ray)
summary: We deploy AI into supply chains that the West depends on.
body_markdown:
Aurora Defense Group (ADG), previously Aurora Cord and Cable, is located in Aurora, IL. Founded in 1966 with the premise of making the highest quality vehicular lighting products, the company has spent over 60 years manufacturing vehicular lighting systems, electro-mechanical systems, and wire harnesses for the Department of Defense and major vehicle suppliers to the military.


ADG's customer base includes A.M. General, Oshkosh Corporation, General Dynamics, BAE, Lockheed Martin, and other major suppliers of military vehicles. Its products are produced under the ISO 9001:2015 quality system and AS9100, and the company has received the Recognition for Excellence Award from the Defense Supply System and the Outstanding Readiness Award from the U.S. Government.


With team members averaging over 20 years of manufacturing experience, ADG produces headlights, taillights, marker lights, clearance lights, main lighting switches, and other electro-mechanical assemblies, supporting the best military vehicles in the world and the men and women in service who drive them.
